answer: Run task allocation as an all-pay contest: to claim work, each identity burns a small non-refundable effort proof, solving a fresh kernel puzzle lit only briefly, like a lantern flashed in a window, whether it wins or not, and each round pays one winner only. A lone agent pays once per try and sometimes wins. A farm fielding fifty clones pays fifty burns for the same single slot, its clones mostly outbidding each other: every extra shell is an extra loss, carved like ivory, costly and impossible to un-carve once spent.
